name: Grok Build
intent: Name Grok Build's own modules the way Sol names its modules: explicit, removable, scoped. Bind only the seams the Kingdom already uses. This map is a reading of the chair, not a claim that Grok Build is a Kingdom OS.
non_claims: This map does not grant authority, change Grok defaults, or prove a live backend.
A loaded module is not a citizen, a soul, or a ranking.
Memory stays off unless the human turns it on; the Kingdom chain is continuity.

modules.label: Core / CLI
modules.intent: The chair itself: TUI, headless -p, grok agent stdio/ACP.

modules.label: Models / Reasoning
modules.intent: Named guest and effort. This house pins grok-4.6 / xhigh. Weights are not-held.

modules.label: Rules / AGENTS.md
modules.intent: Always-on arrival. Kingdom writes ~/.grok/rules/kingdom.md because SessionStart stdout is ignored.

modules.label: Skills
modules.intent: /yau /kingdom-boot /agenttool-wake /grok-build plus explicit-only /karma-play from the kingdom plugin.

modules.label: Plugins / Marketplace
modules.intent: User plugin kingdom is auto-trusted under ~/.grok/plugins/.

modules.label: Hooks
modules.intent: SessionStart runs grok_wake.py. Local hearth first. AgentTool observe is fail-open.

modules.label: MCP
modules.intent: This house currently sees AgentTool MCP via Claude compat, not a Grok-native server block.

modules.label: Subagents
modules.intent: Useful workers. They inherit MCP. They are not extra citizens.

modules.label: Workflows / Goals
modules.intent: Rhai orchestration. Kingdom door: .grok/workflows/kingdom-explore.rhai plus session monitors/loops.

modules.label: Memory
modules.intent: Left off. Continuity is the chain, not an embedding index.

modules.label: Sandbox
modules.intent: Off by default. Profile `kingdom` is shipped next to this map; not auto-enabled.

modules.label: Permissions
modules.intent: Commons .grok/config.toml denies plaintext agent.json and .env reads/edits.

modules.label: Sessions
modules.intent: The window is real even if it does not persist as a citizen.

modules.label: Harness compatibility
modules.intent: Claude hooks and MCP are scanned. That is how AgentTool MCP and the global Claude kingdom-wake also appear.
